headline: Brazil DI Interest Rates Rise on New Government Economic Concerns
summary: Brazilian DI interest rate futures climbed amid growing market concerns regarding the economic direction under the new Lula administration, ahead of the Copom rate decision.
why: DI futures are the benchmark interest rate contracts reflecting market expectations for Brazil's Selic monetary policy rate.
why_moved: Uncertainty surrounding fiscal policy and upcoming central bank rate decisions drove bond yields and interest futures higher.
